traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Action meets disruption. Impulsive, risk-taking, rebellious energy, with impatience and a pull toward technology. The trine makes this a natural strength: Quick, original action and inventive problem-solving. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Drive and disruption flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what drive and disruption have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Innovative and fast; the cost is recklessness and volatility.
shadow: The ease lets anger and recklessness and instability for its own sake go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.
